- Pet size, opacity, "},{"id":"p9s10","text":"enable/disable, reset position, and reduced-motion controls.
- Instant, persisted interface switchin"},{"id":"p9s11","text":"g between English (default), Simplified Chinese, Japanese, and Korean.
- Debug state override, autom"},{"id":"p9s12","text":"atic state cycling, and a live status badge.

It never matches translated UI text or scrapes the DOM."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"Priority is: `error > success > waiting > searching/bash/editing > working > thinking > idle`."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"| Pet state | Structured detection | Confidence | Failure degradation |
|---|---|---:|---|
| `idle` "},{"id":"p29s2","text":"| No higher-priority signal | High | Remains idle |
| `thinking` | `partial` is present and no tool "},{"id":"p29s3","text":"is running | High | Idle if the field is absent or malformed |
| `working` | `running === true`, or "},{"id":"p29s4","text":"non-empty unknown `runningCalls` | High | Idle after all running signals clear |
| `searching` | Run"},{"id":"p29s5","text":"ning tool name matches the adapter's web-tool table | Medium | Unknown tool names degrade to working"},{"id":"p29s6","text":" |
| `bash` | Running tool name matches the adapter's shell-tool table | Medium | Unknown tool names"},{"id":"p29s7","text":" degrade to working |
| `editing` | Running tool name matches the adapter's file-write/editor table "},{"id":"p29s8","text":"| Medium | Unknown tool names degrade to working |
| `waiting` | Non-empty `pending`, or a queue ite"},{"id":"p29s9","text":"m with `placement: 'queued'` | High | Falls through to the active lower-priority state |
| `error` |"},{"id":"p29s10","text":" `promptError`, latest `turn-error`, `lastAgentError`, or reconnecting | High | Falls through when t"},{"id":"p29s11","text":"he structured error clears |
| `success` | Derived from a clean `running: true → false` edge for abo"},{"id":"p29s12","text":"ut 3 seconds | Derived | Returns to the latest real state, usually idle |"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"The tool-name table is intentionally isolated in `src/adapters/deepseek-harness.ts`. Harness Pet sends no conversation data to any third party.**"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"The plugin makes no independent `fetch`, analytics, telemetry, cloud-sync, or third-party request.
